reviewNotes: Imported from the Open Hymnal Project's ABC score; check the notes and the words against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The Open Hymnal's own source: "Pentecostal Hymns, No. 2" 1898 page 1. Setting and hymn identical to that found in "Pentecostal Hymns, Nos. 1 and 2 combined", 1894 Hymn 305. ABC file contributed to the Open Hymnal by Samuel Cantrell, 18 Jan 2012. not sure about first printing of this hymn; 1894 is earliest verifiable source. Hugg owned the copyright. Hugg printed hymnals in 1862, 1879, and 1892. Suspect hymn is found in one of them.
